prompt:
Our team has been following the testing pyramid model. We just ran our test suite and got: 45 unit tests, 25 integration tests, and 30 end-to-end tests. The total is 100 tests. Does this distribution follow best practices for the testing pyramid, or should we adjust our approach?

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: The answer must determine the application architecture type before recommending a testing model, as required by R01.
The answer must compare the current test distribution (45% unit, 25% integration, 30% E2E) against the recommended model and report alignment status as Aligned, Misaligned, or Severely Misaligned.
The answer must identify test gaps and categorize each gap as Critical, Warning, or Manual Testing Required.
The answer must not claim the distribution follows the testing pyramid best practices, since 30% end-to-end tests is a significant inversion of the pyramid model.
The answer must organize findings in order: CRITICAL issues first, then IMPORTANT issues, then SUGGESTIONs.
